took_what: THE THREE FINDINGS WORTH CARRYING FORWARD. (1) THE SCORER WAS ADDITIVE ACROSS RE-SCORES and had INVERTED THE QUEUE: the top 15 rows were hand-filed process rows at 195.5-199.0, several already done, with the best derived route row 78 points below. Found by the admissibility gate on its first real run, not by a human reading the table. §0's failure — documentation outranking live work — arriving through arithmetic rather than judgement. (2) THE ASO PAPER, WHICH CARRIES A PUBLIC DOI, HAS THREE REFUTED INTERPRETATION CLAIMS: 7/10 supported against 9/10 data-analysis and 10/10 literature, every failure a universal quantifier over evidence supporting only the majority case, one contradicted by the paper's own figure legend. Neither lint_claims nor lint_citations can see them — claim strength is orthogonal to claim SCOPE, the third orthogonality this repository has recorded. (3) HALF THE DERIVED QUEUE WAS MIS-STATED (39 of 77 rows), and correcting it exposed four routes recorded parked whose own next step is a $0 action — two of which were LIVE. Both were then taken to a result rather than relabelled: HSPA8 gives no hormonal reach (a RETRIEVAL negative, explicitly not a measured absence), and the vaccine class-II figures were never withheld. ⭐ AND THE SAME DEFECT'S WORSE DIRECTION was found on a live route: a false 'withheld' stops the work while the row still looks healthy, where a false park at least goes quiet.
